articles.summary: Travis Upload Go ℠ eliminates manual data entry for small business agents The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV ) today announced the launch of Travis Upload Go℠, an AI-powered quoting tool that streamlines the workers compensation submission process for independent insurance agents serving small businesses. How Travis Upload Go Works Travis Upload Go removes manual data entry from the workers compensation quoting process, allowing agents to spend less time on paperwork and more time with their customers. Through Travis Upload Go , insurance agents upload documents, such as ACORD applications, standard industry forms and handwritten notes, to initiate a quote. The new tool then: Extracts information from the uploaded documents. Prefills account and policy fields. Runs eligibility checks automatically. Generates a bindable workers compensation quote in half the time. What the Data Shows In an August 2026 Travelers survey of more than 150 small business
articles.title: Travelers Introduces AI-Powered Quoting Tool for Workers Compensation

articles.summary: A $50,000 grant will be presented to Smart Home America to help provide FORTIFIED roofs and improve community resilience in Birmingham The Travelers Institute , the public policy division of The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV ), today announced the continuation of its Risk. Regulation. Resilience. Responsibility.℠ education initiative, with a series of events planned this October in four new cities. The multiyear effort brings together policymakers, insurance professionals and consumers to address insurance availability and affordability challenges and build more resilient communities – those better able to prepare for and recover from severe weather and other natural disasters. The new events are scheduled for Oct. 21 in Seattle, Washington; Oct. 22 in Phoenix, Arizona; Oct. 28 in Arlington, Virginia; and Oct. 29 in Birmingham, Alabama, a city that will be highlighted for its leadership in resilience. articles.title: Travelers Institute Brings Insurance Availability and Affordability Conversation to Four New Cities
